lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau kirapaa bhaee daas apanaa keen ||4||25||55||
lines.translation: Nanak has been blessed with God's Mercy; God has made him His Slave. ||4||25||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa kaa aasaraa an naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Hope and Support of His devotees; there is nowhere else for them to go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taan deebaan paravaar dhan prabh teraa naau ||1||
lines.translation: O God, Your Name is my power, realm, relatives and riches. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee apane daas rakh leee ||
lines.translation: God has granted His Mercy, and saved His slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak ni(n)daa kar pache jamakaal graseee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The slanderers rot in their slander; they are seized by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਨਾ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)taa ek dhiaavanaa doosar ko naahi ||
lines.translation: The Saints meditate on the One Lord, and no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ekas aagai benatee raviaa srab thaai ||2||
lines.translation: They offer their prayers to the One Lord, who is pervading and permeating all places. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਇਉ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathaa puraatan iu sunee bhagatan kee baanee ||
lines.translation: I have heard this old story, spoken by the devotees,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਸਟ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਏ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sagal dusat kha(n)d kha(n)d keee jan leee maanee ||3||
lines.translation: that all the wicked are cut apart into pieces, while His humble servants are blessed with honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat bachan naanak kahai paragat sabh maahi ||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the true words, which are obvious to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: prabh ke sevak saran prabh tin kau bhau naahi ||4||26||56||
lines.translation: God's servants are under God's Protection; they have absolutely no fear. ||4||26||56||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਹਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan kaatai so prabhoo jaa kai kal haath ||
lines.translation: God breaks the bonds which hold us; He holds all power in His hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar karam nahee chhooteeai raakhahu har naath ||1||
lines.translation: No other actions will bring release; save me, O my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau saranaagat maadhave pooran daiaal ||
lines.translation: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord of Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੂਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhoot jaai sa(n)saar te raakhai gopaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those whom You preserve and protect, O Lord of the Universe, are saved from the trap of the world. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa bharam bikaar moh in mahi lobhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Hope, doubt, corruption and emotional attachment - in these, he is engrossed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jhooth samagree man vasee paarabraham na jaanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The false material world abides in his mind, and he does not understand the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: param jot pooran purakh sabh jee tumhaare ||
lines.translation: O Perfect Lord of Supreme Light, all beings belong to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu too raakhahi tiu rahaa prabh agam apaare ||3||
lines.translation: As You keep us, we live, O infinite, inaccessible God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh dehi apanaa naau ||
lines.translation: Cause of causes, All-powerful Lord God, please bless me with Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tareeai saadhasa(n)g har har gun gaau ||4||27||57||
lines.translation: Nanak is carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||27||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਤਰਿਆ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan kavan nahee patariaa tumhree parateet ||
lines.translation: Who? Who has not fallen, by placing their hopes in you?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਰਕ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa mohanee mohiaa narak kee reet ||1||
lines.translation: You are enticed by the great enticer - this is the way to hell! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man khutahar teraa nahee bisaas too mahaa udamaadaa ||
lines.translation: O vicious mind, no faith can be placed in you; you are totally intoxicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ ਜਉ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khar kaa paikhar tau chhutai jau oopar laadaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The donkey's leash is only removed, after the load is placed on his back. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਂਡ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam tumh kha(n)de jam ke dukh daa(n)d ||
lines.translation: You destroy the value of chanting, intensive meditation and self-discipline; you shall suffer in pain, beaten by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਰਲਜੇ ਭਾਂਡ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simarahi naahee jon dukh niralaje bhaa(n)d ||2||
lines.translation: You do not meditate, so you shall suffer the pains of reincarnation, you shameless buffoon! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)g sahaaee mahaa meet tis siu teraa bhed ||
lines.translation: The Lord is your Companion, your Helper, your Best Friend; but you disagree with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੀਧਾ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: beedhaa pa(n)ch batavaaraee upajio mahaa khed ||3||
lines.translation: You are in love with the five thieves; this brings terrible pain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin sa(n)tan saranaagatee jin man vas keenaa ||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints, who have conquered their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan sarabas aapanaa prabh jan kau deenhaa ||4||28||58||
lines.translation: He gives body, wealth and everything to the slaves of God. ||4||28||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karat aanad bhaiaa simarat sukh saar ||
lines.translation: Try to meditate, and contemplate the source of peace, and bliss will come to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap naam gobi(n)d kaa pooran beechaar ||1||
lines.translation: Chanting, and meditating on the Name of the Lord of the Universe, perfect understanding is achieved. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur ke japat har jap hau jeevaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Guru, and chanting the Name of the Lord, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਤੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham aaraadhate mukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the Supreme Lord God in adoration, my mouth drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸੇ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲੋਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh sukh base sabh kai man loch ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures dwell in peace; the minds of all yearn for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paraupakaar nit chitavate naahee kachh poch ||2||
lines.translation: Those who continually remember the Lord, do good deeds for others; they harbor no ill will towards anyone. ||2||
